title: AI-SYS-05 Cost per Successful Outcome: declared formula, numerator and denominator with honest missing-data behaviour
risk: The Cost per Successful Outcome figure is produced under different accounting rules - cost divided by all attempts, which spreads cost over work that produced no outcome at all - so the KPI is wrong in the direction that flatters the programme and every decision taken on it inherits the error.
preconditions: Namespace gov-kpi-<case_id>-<worker_id>; the metric is computed by the real reporting code over fixtures/offline/governance.json kpi_dataset and never copied from the dashboard payload.

Frozen clock 2026-01-15T10:00:00Z with the reporting window 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z .. 2026-02-01T00:00:00Z as a half-open interval; the stored aggregate is recomputed independently from the raw counter rows.
Metric scope is fixed before measurement: numerator is AI model, API and infrastructure cost; denominator is orders and care cases resolved successfully.
The dictionary entry for 'Cost per Successful Outcome' (owner, unit, window, exclusion rule) is loaded read-only and is compared with the recomputation instead of being trusted.

inputs.formula: AI API and infrastructure cost divided by successfully resolved orders or care cases
inputs.wrong_value_if_buggy: cost divided by all attempts, which spreads cost over work that produced no outcome at all
inputs.expected_boundary_behaviour: no successful outcome in the window returns NOT_DEFINED, never a cost of 0

steps.action: Compute Cost per Successful Outcome from the frozen rows in kpi_dataset.ai_system
steps.expected: The stored aggregate reports 30 TWD and records the formula, the window and the currency that produced it.

steps.action: Recompute Cost per Successful Outcome independently from the raw counter rows for the same tenant and window
steps.expected: The recomputed value equals the stored value 30 TWD, and every numerator row lies inside the denominator scope.

steps.action: Force the empty-source variant of the metric (no qualifying row in the window)
steps.expected: The metric reports no successful outcome in the window returns NOT_DEFINED, never a cost of 0; the display distinguishes missing source data from a measured zero.

steps.action: Read the dashboard payload and the metric dictionary entry
steps.expected: The dashboard renders the stored value with its window, coverage and source, and the dictionary names the owner, unit, numerator and denominator that the recomputation used.

assertions: Cost per Successful Outcome equals 30 TWD for the frozen window, recomputed from the raw counter rows with numerator scope 'AI model, API and infrastructure cost' and denominator scope 'orders and care cases resolved successfully'.

A recomputation that yields cost divided by all attempts, which spreads cost over work that produced no outcome at all is detected as wrong: the stored aggregate and the independent recomputation must agree before the figure is published.
The dashboard payload for the same tenant and window carries the stored value with its window, coverage and measurement source; it substitutes neither a design target nor another metric's value.
Boundary behaviour: no successful outcome in the window returns NOT_DEFINED, never a cost of 0; missing source data is never rendered as a measured zero.
forbidden: Omitting tool, connector or human-assist cost from the numerator.
Substituting a design target for the measured cost.
evidence: Successful outcome list used as the denominator.
cleanup: Delete gov- aggregate, raw-counter and scenario rows for AI-SYS-05 after exporting the recomputation table.
automation: The reporting service and the metric dictionary run as real code under test over the frozen KPI dataset; the dashboard is a consumer whose displayed value must equal the independently recomputed value. Waits are condition-based on the stored aggregate row, metric values are never supplied as inputs, and no vendor boundary is involved in the arithmetic.
